notes.title: Linux build removed
notes.content:
Hello,

The Linux/SteamOS build of Stonga Bird has been discontinued since it was not working properly. On Linux you can use Proton to run the game perfectly well. Sorry for any trouble.

notes.title: Touchscreen support and Linux build!
notes.content:
Hello all!

Stonga Bird now runs on Linux! Possibly! Let me know if there are any issues.

Also, fixed some buggy behavior when using touch screen for gameplay.

Thanks!

notes.title: Stonga Bird released!
notes.content:
Thank you for your interest my friends!

This patch allows you to change the window's size!

Enjoy!
